tools.name: validate_emails
tools.description: Check up to 10 email addresses: syntax, whether the domain exists and has mail servers (MX), mail provider, disposable, role account (info@, sales@), free provider, likely typo with a suggested fix, domain age, SPF and DMARC. Returns verdict (deliverable_likely/risky/undeliverable/invalid), score 0-

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_emails · Public sink: validate_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_emails · Public sink: validate_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
